variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.body: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.body: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.body: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike. Keep the people behind the story in view, and ask the hard questions without inventing answers.
